name: documents-guide-rules-given
description: A complete guide (31 Oct 2026) with no web: a made-up tabletop game's rules given in the question, and a level-by-level plan asked for. The table must cover every level from 1 to 8, never "endgame" or "reference only" in their place, and name the talents asked for.

turns.user: Here are the rules of my homebrew game Lanternfall. A Warden levels from 1 to 8 and gets 2 skill points a level, for Guard, Light or Grit. Abilities unlock at fixed levels: Shield Wall (1), Lantern Flare (2), Rally (3), Bulwark Stance (4), Beacon (5), Iron Vigil (6), Sunder (7), Last Light (8). Talents come at levels 2, 4, 6 and 8, from Steadfast, Keen Eye, Warden's Oath, Hearthguard and Stormward. Make me a level-by-level plan for a Warden from 1 to 8: the abilities to use, where to put the skill points, and which talent to take.
